caption: The drawing depicts a single large bottle encased in a tightly woven wicker basket covering, which is positioned upright and centrally within the composition. The wicker is colored in various shades of brown, giving it a natural, earthy appearance, with the weaving pattern clearly defined around the entire object. The bottle has a narrow neck that widens toward the base, and its top is sealed with a light blue cap. Attached just below the neck is a thicker, twisted rope handle, similarly colored in a muted brown tone. The background of the image is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or decorative elements present. The artist's signature, "C.W. Dawson," is written in small letters near the bottom right corner.
title: Wicker Demijohn
